description: This Java class 'MessagesView' manages a UI component that displays log messages in a text pane, styling messages based on their source class and handling message display, clearing, and styling.

classes.name: MessagesView
classes.description: A UI component class for displaying and styling logging messages in a Java Swing JTextPane.

methods.name: MessagesView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the message display pane, styles, and message listener.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a new message to the document with appropriate styling.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the style (bold, italic, or default) based on the message's source class.

methods.name: clearMessages
methods.description: Removes all messages from the document.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Public method to clear all displayed messages.
